## Current role

Software Engineer — QA at Openxcell (April 2023 — present). Tests the Speed
crypto payment platform: merchant checkout, payment links, refunds, instant
payouts, swaps, transfers, cashback, on-chain and Lightning Network flows.
Also builds and maintains Aegis-QA.

## Aegis-QA

An AI-driven QA automation platform. It records a real user session, compiles
it to readable Gherkin and a runnable Playwright spec, executes UI, API, flow
and security layers across five runner modes, and repairs its own selectors —
proposed and sandbox-verified, never silently applied. Failed runs are
classified, diagnosed and explained automatically. Python 3.12, Playwright,
asyncio, FastAPI, Next.js.
